I teach mathematics and quantitative methods at the Faculty of Management, AGH University of
Krakow. The courses are taken by students of Management, Management and Production Engineering,
and Computer Science and Econometrics, so the emphasis falls on a solid grasp of the material and
on the uses it is put to.

## For students

I am happy to co-supervise theses that use Input-Output methods, environmental accounting or
applied statistics. If you have an idea in that area, or would simply like to talk
through the possibilities, let me know.
